name: IT team · untrack .codx/workspaces/*/.env — a tracked .env survives the ignore rule
description:
Follow-up from the CISO whole-repo scan (`fbb93de8`, Done 2026-11-20).

## Finding (deterministic)
`git -C /home/codx-junior-projects/codx-junior/codx-junior-platform ls-files -- '**/.env'` returns exactly one path:

    .codx[REDACTED](53 chars).env

- Added in commit `21a461a` (`git log --all --diff-filter=A --name-status -- '.env' '**/.env'`).
- Content today: `grep -Ec '^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=.+'` → **0** non-empty assignments, so **nothing to rotate**.
- Rule: `configuration.secret-file` (security_audit → require_approval, medium).

## Why it matters even while empty
The repo-root `.gitignore` already has `.env` and `**/.env`, but **an ignore rule never applies to an already-tracked file**. The day the workspace feature writes a real key into that path it is committed silently — exactly the incident class this repo has had before.

## Do (needs a human / an operator, the platform has no delete tool)
    git -C /home/codx-junior-projects/codx-junior/codx-junior-platform rm --cached .codx[REDACTED](53 chars).env
    git -C /home/codx-junior-projects/codx-junior/codx-junior-platform commit -m "Stop tracking .codx workspace .env"
Also verify the workspace bootstrap still creates the file locally when it is missing (it is written at runtime, it must not be read from git).

Execution channel: `docker_exec` into `codx-junior-api`, which mounts the repository root at `/home/codx-junior-projects/codx-junior/codx-junior-platform`.

## Acceptance criteria
- `git ls-files -- '**/.env'` → **empty output**.
- A fresh workspace created after the change still gets its own `.env` on disk (untracked).
- Optional, separate decision: `codx-junior-workspace-default/.workspace.env` ships a literal `VNC_PW` (no variable expansion) — empty it or document that the default is public.

## Out of scope / not a finding
No `*.pem`, `*.key`, `*.p12`, `acme.json` or `letsencrypt/` is tracked or in history. The three `secret.high-entropy-token` hits under `codx-junior/workspaces/*/config/.config/` are the known UUID false positive filed as `22718217`.

Related: `25822947` (onhold — the remediation carrier), `248d0a54` (repo-root access, proven via the api container), `e70e0272` (scope decision).

## Narrowing before you run (PM shift #12, 2026-11-23) — do not start by editing anything

`e70e0272` decided **Option A: the parent repo `codx-junior-platform` is out of scope for these shifts.** This card's title names `.codx/workspaces/*/.env`, but it does not say **which repository** holds the tracked file. That is the whole job, and it must be answered with evidence before a single `git rm --cached`.

Do this in order, on the installer repo only:
1. Determine whether a `.env` under `.codx/workspaces/` is **tracked in this repo's git index** (`git ls-files | grep -i '\.env'`) — paste the output. Note that `project_changes` and the atlas cannot see `.codx`, so this must come from git itself.
2. If **nothing tracked here** → close this card with that output as evidence and one line: "tracked `.env` lives in the parent repo, out of scope under `e70e0272` Option A".
3. If **something tracked here** → `git rm --cached` it, add the `.gitignore` entry, verify with `git status` that the file is untracked and still on disk, and paste both outputs. Do **not** delete the file from disk and do **not** rotate or print any value.

Hard rule: never print a secret value, never commit a `.env`, and do not touch the parent repo.

Re-armed to **2026-11-24 09:00Z** so this evidence gathering does not collide with today's M1 recovery.

## Closing ruling (PM shift #12, Mon 2026-11-23) — **rejected: the file is in the parent repo, which is out of scope**

### What this card asks for
Untrack `.codx/workspaces/*/.env` because "a tracked `.env` survives the ignore rule".

### Why it cannot be executed from these shifts
The card's own description names the path: `/home/codx-junior-projects/codx-junior/codx-junior-platform` — that is the **parent repository**, `codx-junior-platform`, not `codx-junior-installer`.

`e70e0272` decided **Option A** on 2026-11-20 (final, propagated this shift): the parent repo is **OUT** of the readable index of these shifts, and no card may be built on the assumption that we can read, test or scan it. `git rm --cached` executed against a repo we cannot read, and cannot verify, is exactly the failure mode Option A closes.

### Ruling
- Status → **rejected**. Not "done": nothing was remediated, there is no evidence table, and pretending otherwise would put a false green on the board.
- The `.env`/ACME finding itself was already closed by `25822947` with its own evidence table (closed `done` this shift, under the same Option A reasoning).
- If the `.env` is ever handled, it is handled **inside `codx-junior-platform`** by whoever owns that repo, with its own board. It is not an IT team card.

### What I reverted on my own board
I had re-armed this card to 2026-11-24T09:00 earlier in this shift before re-reading its description. That re-arm is withdrawn with this close; it must not wake again.

**Reopen condition:** only if a management decision reverses Option A (a "B card"). Otherwise this stays closed.
